We're organising a two-day seaside music festival on the harbour front at Parc del
Fòrum, Barcelona, on 9 June 2026. We expect a peak crowd of around 80,000 people across
the waterfront stages and piers. The total budget set aside for shade and shelter
structures is €500,000. The whole event leans hard into a maritime, harbour-and-sails
aesthetic — think sailcloth canopies, rope rigging, and a working-port feel along the
quayside.
